decisions.reason: As a bread loaf close to the core bakery range, it is easy to absorb into the existing offer and the firm's public listing of it makes management inclined to continue rather than admit a failed launch.

The guided historic mill tour builds on the firm's heritage and visitor experience, likely involves visible commitment and dedicated setup, and escalation of commitment therefore makes withdrawal relatively unlikely.
The sweet pastry fits the established confectionery business and, once publicly introduced, management is likely to retain it unless clear persistent failure emerges, which is not indicated here.
